ask.text: Write the load.

hints.text: A load standing on one pan. It settles inward-out.
A take-away does not turn freely. Carry the sign with the term.
The 7 term is going first, and it was never a positive one.

worldFraming.text: Some joins in this load turn freely. Some are keyed and will not turn at all.

ask.text: Let it settle and read it.

hints.text: A load standing on one pan. It settles inward-out.
The whole bundle is coming off, not just the front of it.
The bundle weighs 8, and all of it is leaving 12.

worldFraming.text: Some joins in this load turn freely. Some are keyed and will not turn at all.

ask.text: Write the load.

hints.text: A load standing on one pan. It settles inward-out.
A count of nothing carries nothing, however big the term looks.
The 5 term is holding zero of itself. One socket is still standing.

worldFraming.text: You learn which is which with your hands, standing on it.

ask.text: Name the joint that will not hold, and what it should read.

hints.text: A load standing on one pan. It settles inward-out.
Read down the working. One line does not follow from the one above it.
Line 2 is where the load stops matching.
